title: Greedy STOP-margin and shortest-proof rule ranking
motivation: AF20 paired relative ordering can be correct while both examples execute greedy STOP. The logsumexp-rule mass gap differs from the host's best-legal-rule greedy decision gap by up to log(number_of_legal_rules).

model.host_rule_legality: Only premise-enabled original public Horn rules can add a new proved head; STOP remains legal. Every accepted proof independently checked.

data.split_ownership: Training uses inherited AF20 train-only source and exact AF20 paired roster. Development checks eligibility. New compositions, physical layouts and heldouts are reserved for fixed final checkpoints.
data.features: Only public initial facts, Horn incidence, role bits, current host-known facts and legal-rule mask. Shortest distances and optimal actions are source labels, excluded from model input.
data.pair_scope: Heldout counterfactuals alter exactly one initial fact in a fixed graph and layout; flip or connected-and-equal-shortest-cost cases are independently recomputed.
data.novelty_limit: Novel recombinations of established unary/binary Horn operators, not a novel logic or general Lean theorem search.

fitting.common_loss: AF20 original shortest-action CE, mass STOP BCE, reach BCE, action-cost and distance Huber on 32 main states; identical AF20 pair-member reach BCE and STOP mass BCE on 16 pairs at 0.4 multiplier.
fitting.common_extra_forward: All four arms execute one additional identical main-state forward to measure true greedy margin and optimal-rule ranking; BCE drops gradient from this pass. All arms have matched forward calls during the first 240 optimizer steps; additional gradient FLOPs are not matched.
fitting.greedy_margin: m=STOP logit - max(enabled rule logits). For nonterminal reachable states require m<=-gamma; when exact STOP is optimal and a competing rule is enabled, require m>=gamma.
fitting.greedy_margin_penalty: softplus(gamma+m) if must-continue, softplus(gamma-m) if must-STOP; gamma=0.5, weight 0.5 on primary plus 0.25 on identical paired source states.
fitting.rule_ranking_penalty: softplus(gamma+max(suboptimal legal rule logits)-max(optimal legal rule logits)) for reachable states possessing both action classes; coefficient 0.4 on primary plus half-weight on pair members.

arms.greedy_l4: common + direct greedy STOP margin; 240 updates
arms.greedy_rule_l4: common + direct greedy STOP margin + optimal-rule ranking; 240 updates
arms.greedy_rule_extra_l4: same as greedy_rule with 360 updates; explicit higher-compute sensitivity control

fitting.checkpoint: Use final step only, no validation or heldout checkpoint selection, all seeds including failures retained
fitting.runtime_scientific: Python 3.12 / torch 2.5.1+cpu / Lean 4.19.0 GitHub Actions when runner available; local Python 3.13/torch 2.10+cpu separately labeled

verification.lean: Kernel-check Bellman-descent implies reaching cost zero within the original proof distance under exact descent, plus strict score dominance hypothesis. Not model convergence.
verification.independent_audit: Rebuild each rule from physical incidence, solve separate BFS shortest proof, verify every accepted proof action and budget, every paired source target, every saved logit checksum and Torch/NumPy weights and sampled actual forward replays.
verification.formal_scope: Sound host inference and conditional Bellman implication. Lean proof does not establish neural or synthetic task generalization.

scoring.eligibility: bce_l4, greedy_l4 and greedy_rule_l4 must each score >=0.65 train and >=0.65 dev provable-goal proof success to qualify the seed; extended training control is scored but not used for eligibility.
scoring.primary: greedy_rule_l4 compared with bce_l4 on held_depth4 and held_depth5 separately
scoring.primary_gate: For each eligible seed and at both held depths, greedy_rule success - bce success >=0.05, greedy_rule absolute success >=0.70, early STOP positive <= bce+0.02, initial-state reachable/unreachable flip joint-order accuracy >=0.75, connected-distractor reach and STOP probability mean abs shift <=0.10 and <=bce+0.02, no false accepted Horn proofs. Any eligible failure is FAIL, all eligible and passing is PASS, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
scoring.baseline: Fixed rule-slot order, uniform legal choice and exact shortest proof ceiling are scored under the same source host budget.
scoring.failure_policy: Preserve all eligible failures, ineligible seed results, prior AF01-AF20 negative outcomes, source hashes and original artifacts. Draft and unmerged pending review.
